pe.title: On-page edit
pe.sub: Change a shop page while you look at it: only you, the owner, see the bar.
pe.readOnly: You can look at this page; changing it needs permission to change page layouts.

master.title: On-page edit mode
master.on: On: when you are signed in as the owner, every shop page shows a thin bar with Edit mode.
master.off: Off: no shop page loads anything for it.
master.who: Only the owner (super admin) sees the bar. Customers and other staff never do. Prices, offers and money are shown with a link to their own page; the bag and the checkout's payment steps are locked.

phone.title: Phone and computer
phone.sub: How a change made on a computer reaches phones.
phone.phoneLightHint: On a phone the panel shows texts and offers only, with no moving or numbers.
phone.askPhoneHint: Yes checks every phone size first and publishes only when they pass and you say OK; No keeps the change to computers where it can (a section shown or hidden).

checks.title: Automatic phone checks
checks.taps: Everything big enough to tap (in the changed sections)
checks.buyFold: Buy button on the first screen (product pages)
checks.farm: These run in your own browser on each phone size. A check on real phones (device farm) and the AI reviewer are not available here.

more.title: More options
more.sub: Sizes the checks use and the phone screens they run on.
more.inlineLinkMinPx: Smallest height of a link inside text (px)
more.name: Name
more.reset: Back to the 10 most used in Bangladesh

log.title: On-page publishes
log.sub: Every publish from the shop page. Each one is also on Website › Launch default, where the newest can be undone.
log.empty: Nothing published from a shop page yet.

pe.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved.

err.STALE: Someone saved this page in between. It was loaded again; make your change again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: A value does not fit. Check the sizes and names.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this.
err.other: That did not work. Try again.
